messages.subject: Lunch & learn: AI and the SaaS contract — Thursday 24 April
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi both,

The commercial team is running a lunch & learn on 'AI clauses in SaaS and data agreements' on Thursday 24 April, 12:30–13:30 in the Bishopsgate training room. Sandwiches provided. RSVP to me if you'd like a place — it counts towards your CPD hours.

Donna
